Plot fitted behavioural states

Source: R/plot.R
plot.ssf_fit.Rd

Draw a track coloured by its Viterbi labels or show the smoothed state probabilities in step order. Guided fits use the ecological labels of the selected taxonomy. The probability curves are conditional on the fitted model and stop at segment boundaries.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ssf_fit'
plot(
  x,
  ...,
  type = c("auto", "track", "posterior", "states"),
  segment = NULL,
  step_range = NULL,
  coords = c("x0", "y0", "x", "y")
)

# S3 method for class 'guided_ssf'
plot(
  x,
  ...,
  type = c("auto", "track", "posterior", "states"),
  segment = NULL,
  step_range = NULL,
  coords = c("x0", "y0", "x", "y")
)

Arguments

x

An object from fit_ssf() or fit_guided_ssf().

...

For type = "states", arguments passed to plot_ssf_states(). Otherwise reserved for the generic.

type

Use "track" for a map, "posterior" for state probabilities, or "auto" for a map when the chosen coordinate columns are available and a probability plot otherwise. "states" combines the ecological interpretation, observed movement distributions and estimated effects.

segment

Optional segment identifiers from the fitted ID column.

step_range

Optional pair giving the first and last step to draw, counted in fitted order after selecting segments.

coords

Four numeric columns in the fitted observations for start x, start y, end x and end y, respectively. Use projected coordinates in common units.

Value

A ggplot object.
